title: She Texted First
description:
A notification.
Daeun.
"Hey, how have you been lately?"

She's never reached out first.
{name} looked at the screen for a moment, then started typing.

choices.text: Write a long reply. Talk properly.  (connection / deepening)
choices.result_text:
An hour of back-and-forth messages.
From the triangle kimbap day to now — seemed like a lot had changed, and then again not much.
Daeun said, "Let's get coffee sometime."

choices.text: Short reply. Keep the connection.  (balance / distance)
choices.result_text:
"Doing okay, you?"
A few messages exchanged, then it faded.
The thread stayed warm.

title: Hyunsu's Favor
description:
Over drinks at the pojangmacha, Hyunsu brought it up.
"Hyung, could you lend me ₩1,000,000 for a month? I need it fast."

Close like brothers. Had to ask why.
"There's an investment deal — I don't want to miss the timing."

choices.text: Lend it. Trust Hyunsu.  (friendship / risk)
choices.result_text:
Sent the transfer. Hyunsu was grateful.
A month passed — paid back a little late, but paid back.

choices.text: Can't do it. Not in a position to right now.  (self-protection / awkward aftermath)
choices.result_text:
Hyunsu said, "Fair enough, can't be helped."
The energy at the table dropped.
{name} kept thinking about whether the refusal was right.

choices.text: ₩500,000 is what's possible.  (compromise / relationship)
choices.result_text:
"Can do five hundred." {name} said.
Hyunsu was grateful. Sourced the rest from somewhere else.

title: What Sangchul Said
description:
Coffee stretching into a long conversation.
Sangchul brought up an old story.
Early thirties — he'd been trying to build everything fast, exactly like {name} now.

"The last thing I figured out — direction matters more than speed."

choices.text: Take it seriously. Check the direction.  (wisdom / recalibration)
choices.result_text:
{name} came home and opened a notebook.
Fast — or right direction?
First time really asking that question.

choices.text: Nod along, but stay the course.  (confidence / closed to learning)
choices.result_text:
Nodded — but inside, stood firm.
Sangchul's path and {name}'s path are different.

title: Father's Silence
description:
Eating together, just the two of them, for the first time in a while.
Both quiet.
Father glanced at {name} a few times over the rice, then looked away.

Looked like something almost said.

choices.text: Reach out first. "How are you, Dad?"  (approach / awkwardness)
choices.result_text:
Father stopped.
"Same as always," he said.
Then put down his spoon.
"You've been looking tired lately."
They talked for a long time after that — first real conversation in years.

choices.text: Just eat. This kind of quiet is familiar.  (comfortable distance / connection missed)
choices.result_text:
Finished the meal and parted ways.
Watched Dad's back at the bus stop.
Should have said something — next time.

title: Something Mom Never Said
description:
Mom brought up something from a long time ago.
When she was young — there was something she wanted to do.
Could have been a career. She let it go when she got married.

"No regrets. But sometimes I wonder. What if I'd gone that way?"

choices.text: Listen to the whole story.  (understanding / connection)
choices.result_text:
{name} saw Mom as a full person for the first time — not just a parent.
A long conversation followed.
On the walk home: {name}'s path can't be given up.

choices.text: "It's not too late, Mom." Encourage her.  (courage / warmth)
choices.result_text:
Mom laughed. "What would I even do now."
But something in her eyes shifted.

title: A Friend's Heartbreak
description:
Friend called suddenly, asked to meet at the pojangmacha.
Broke up. Three years.

{name} poured drinks and listened. Didn't need to say much.

choices.text: Stay until late. That's the whole thing.  (friendship / tired tomorrow)
choices.result_text:
Stayed until past midnight.
Friend cried a lot.
{name} called a taxi at the end.
Friend said "thank you" — two words that covered everything.

choices.text: Stay two hours, then head out.  (balance / slight guilt)
choices.result_text:
"Got to get going, sorry."
"No, you came — that's enough."
Left feeling like staying longer would have been better.

title: An Old Name
description:
A KakaoTalk from someone contact had been lost with.
An ex.
"Hey. Long time."

Why now. {name} looked at the screen.
Respond well? Honestly?

choices.text: "Doing well, you?" — safe conversation.  (neutral connection / managed feelings)
choices.result_text:
Short pleasantries. Awkward but not bad.
The connection hadn't fully gone.

choices.text: "Why are you reaching out?" — ask directly.  (direct / awkward)
choices.result_text:
A pause.
"Just thought of you."
That led somewhere longer.

choices.text: Don't reply. Not the right moment.  (self-protection / closed door)
choices.result_text:
{name} closed the chat.
Not rude — just: not now.

title: Last Coffee
description:
Sangchul spoke slowly today.
"When you get old, what's left is relationships. Money's fine — but there's nowhere to spend it alone."

{name} said nothing. Just listened.

choices.text: Write it down. Won't forget this.  (learning / record)
choices.result_text:
Typed it in the notes app on the walk home.
'Nowhere to spend it alone.'
The ₩3B goal stands — but someone to share it with has to exist too.

choices.text: "Work comes first for me, still." Say it honestly.  (conviction / respect)
choices.result_text:
Sangchul smiled. "Good. I was the same."
Not the wrong road — just heard that from the right person.

title: Overheard
description:
Coming out of the bathroom — two colleagues talking.
Shouldn't have heard it.
Personnel information. The kind that directly affects {name}.

choices.text: Pretend it wasn't heard. Wait for the official announcement.  (principle / unready)
choices.result_text:
Walked past as if nothing happened.
The information refused to leave anyway.

choices.text: Quietly verify with the colleague.  (information / awkward relationship)
choices.result_text:
Colleague was flustered — then confirmed.
{name} could prepare early.
Got a little closer to that colleague in the process.

choices.text: Use the information to quietly prepare.  (pragmatic / moral discomfort)
choices.result_text:
{name} moved quietly.
No bad intent — just prepared early.
Left a faint unease that didn't quite go away.

title: Same Starting Line
description:
Found them on social media by accident.
Same neighborhood, growing up — competed at everything.
Now: executive at a major conglomerate.

Does that person still remember those years?

choices.text: Reach out. It's been a while.  (reconnection / comparison risk)
choices.result_text:
Warm response. Suggested meeting for a meal.
Two people who started from the same spot, now on different roads —
Curious to see where the conversation goes.

choices.text: Just watch from a distance.  (observation / held back)
choices.result_text:
Followed the account.
Watching quietly — what they're doing, where they're going.
